Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Garrett
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 01/27/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 85 as introduced would allow members of the Security for Alabama Funds Enhancement (SAFE) program board of directors, or any committee established by the SAFE board, to attend meetings virtually which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Date: 04/05/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 85 as passed the House of Representatives would allow members of the Security for Alabama Funds Enhancement (SAFE) program board of directors, or any committee established by the SAFE board, to attend meetings virtually which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
